upper.prompt:
Create a production transparent clothing sprite sheet for the blue storybook ghost in reference 1. Reference 2 shows the previous failed clothes: improve them radically. Preserve the reference ghost silhouette: big round teardrop head, detached mitten hands, broad flowing scalloped wisp hem, absolutely no human legs. Draw CLOTHES ONLY, no ghost or mannequin. The clothes must wrap the entire small floating lower body like softly draped ponchos, with curved folds, side openings for the floating hands, and a scalloped flowing bottom following the wisp outline. Avoid tiny human shirts, isolated rectangles or flat pasted-on icons. The garment upper opening sits tucked just under the head; its width grows naturally down to a broad gently scalloped hem. The front/back are complete continuous fabric, with visible cloth thickness at the rolled lower edge, gentle shaded side folds and fine warm pencil seams. Soft matte gouache, watercolor pigment grain, warm fine hand drawn outlines, muted oatmeal cream main fabric, sage secondary trim, tiny brass fasteners. No gloss, 3D, vector, pixel art or white sticker edge.
Make exactly EIGHT COLUMNS and EIGHT ROWS with generous clear transparent gutters between all 64 separate garments. Each column is one design repeated in eight directions down its column. Columns left to right: 1 linen ghost poncho with two front buttons; 2 knitted ghost shoulder-cowl with ribbed scalloped hem; 3 gardening ghost smock with apron pocket; 4 open-front ghost waistcoat draping to sides, curved bottom; 5 ghost sundress flowing continuously from neck to wisp hem with sage petal edging; 6 long elegant ghost festival robe with embroidered hem; 7 ghost pinafore draping over whole wisp, short shoulder straps and apron pocket; 8 ONE curved softly folded cloth under-hem sash with sage trim (no legs, no belt buckle, continuous curved fabric).
Rows top to bottom are S facing camera, SW front-left, W left profile, NW rear-left, N full back, NE rear-right, E right profile, SE front-right. Camera is fixed elevated isometric. Each row must show corresponding turned surfaces and attachment openings, not identical frontal icons. Keep matching proportions, garment identity, lengths and materials across all directions. Profile garments have believable side folds. Every separate garment centered within equal cell, all whole, no clipping or intersecting cells. Aim 2048 square. No labels, numbers, grid lines, scenery, character parts, cast shadows or background. True transparent alpha.

upper_se.prompt: Create the missing final SE (front-right three-quarter) direction row for this exact ghost garment sheet. Draw EIGHT separate clothes ONLY in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW on true transparent background, same painted gouache materials, warm pencil edges, cream, sage and brass palette, ghost wisp shaped flowing drape, matching the reference designs and proportions exactly. Left to right: two-button linen poncho; knitted sage cowl with cream scalloped hem; gardening apron smock with leaf pocket; open-front sage embroidered waistcoat; cream petal-edge sundress; cream embroidered festival robe; cream leaf-pocket pinafore with sage side panels; curved folded cream under-hem sash with sage trim. All face SE front-right, showing their FRONT and RIGHT SIDE, not backs. Keep generous transparent gutters, all complete. No ghost, body, mannequin, text, grid, shadow or scenery. Canvas wide 8:1, eight equal cells. The empty garments have complete painted front surfaces and curved openings. No tiny human shirts or human legs.

shoes.prompt: Production transparent sprite sheet for ghost footwear alternatives. Reference ghost has a big round head, mitten hands and a flowing scalloped wisp body with NO legs or feet. Draw ornaments ONLY. Footwear must be two SHORT hanging fabric or leather tips physically attached to the outer hem edge, in natural vertical draped orientation. They must NOT be tiny shoes, boots, horizontal flattened scraps, detached rings or four layered strips. Each pair is two little tapered hanging tabs, each with a curved attachment fold at its top, a small material detail and rounded point below. Aim the pair at lower left and lower right of a wisp skirt, wide apart, attached at the top. Matte soft gouache and watercolor grain, thin warm dark pencil contour, restrained oatmeal cream/sage/ochre brass/leather brown. FOUR COLUMNS by EIGHT ROWS exactly, 32 isolated pairs. Columns: 1 leather lace tabs; 2 tiny polished wooden toggle charms suspended by short cloth ties; 3 soft felt petal tabs; 4 rainproof sage folded cloth tabs with two brass studs. Rows S, SW, W, NW, N, NE, E, SE, all elevated isometric with the ghost turning toward that direction. A side view pair overlaps naturally so near tab is visible, far tab partly hidden. Back rows show plain backs, front rows show details. Each pair stays inside its own equal cell with generous transparent gutters. No body, mannequin, legs, feet, text, labels, grid, scenery, shadows or background. True transparent alpha. Wide canvas 1:2.

upper_rear.prompt: Create precise rear turnaround clothing sprites for the attached ghost garment sheet. EIGHT COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, exactly 24 separate clothes on true transparent alpha. The reference is the approved design and painted style. Draw CLOTHES ONLY, no ghost/mannequin. Every design must now show its BACK: hide all front buttons, breast ties, apron pockets and open front panels. Back surfaces are unbroken draping cloth, with only shoulder seams, matching edging, rear strap joins where appropriate. Column order must remain: 1 cream linen poncho with sage neckline and scalloped hem; 2 sage knitted shoulder-cowl over cream scalloped hem; 3 cream gardening smock with sage edge, NO pocket on back; 4 sage leaf-embroidered ghost waistcoat, closed continuous back panel; 5 cream sundress with sage petal-edge hem, NO front neck tie; 6 cream festival robe with gold embroidered hem; 7 cream pinafore with sage crossed straps joining at upper back, NO pocket on back; 8 cream curved under-hem sash with sage fold. Row 1 NW rear-left, row 2 N straight back, row 3 NE rear-right. Preserve identical wisp-shaped wide draped silhouettes, generous transparent gutters, soft matte gouache and watercolor grain, fine warm brown pencil outlines, oatmeal cream/sage/ochre brass pigments. No human legs, feet, heads, ordinary human shirt proportions, labels, text, scenery, grid, shadows or background. All 24 garments entire and centered in their equal cells. Wide landscape canvas 8:3.
